title: Doubling a word with a leading bit
statement: For every Boolean bit $b$ and every finite Boolean word $w$, doubling the word formed by placing $b$ at the beginning of $w$ gives two copies of $b$ followed by the doubling of $w$.
replaced:
For every bit $b$ and every bit string $w$, the doubling of the string $b\,w$
(where $\mathrm{dbl}(v)$ writes each bit of $v$ twice in succession) is
$b\,b$ followed by $\mathrm{dbl}(w)$; that is,
$\mathrm{dbl}(b\,w) = b\,b\,\mathrm{dbl}(w)$.
